title: Hematopoietic readouts: scientific code and aggregate source tables
description:
Manuscript-specific software for Cell composition and endpoint proximity constrain model-derived fate interpretations in three hematopoietic single-cell datasets.

Original display and retained-artifact scientific replay utilities, aggregate source tables, numerical display references and upstream notices are included. Per-cell identifiers, count matrices, model outputs and fitted encoder artifacts are supplied separately as Supplementary Code 1 and Supplementary Data 1–8. Aggregate display reproduction, retained-artifact replay and full raw-data/model retraining have distinct boundaries. This release does not establish raw preparation, full model retraining or independent biological validation.

MIT terms apply to original software and its software documentation. Aggregate tables, source datasets and upstream code retain their own terms and attribution; see LICENSE, NOTICE.md and DATA_SOURCES.md.

Sole author: Zeyu Fu; ORCID 0009-0001-8329-0108. Correspondence: fuzeyu99@tmmu.edu.cn; fuzeyu99@126.com.

Software edition 1.0.2 corrects main-figure legend placement and clarifies portable instructions for Tables S1–S21 and the separate Table S20 sensitivity calculation. Vector PDF, editable SVG and PNG displays remain supported for six main and two supplementary figures. Scientific inputs, aggregate numerical results and the 378-value main, 376-value supplementary and five-value Figure 3 context ledgers are unchanged. No Zenodo DOI has been assigned to this edition. The previous software version 1.0.0 is archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23435592.
